source_visual_observations: Two horizontal parallel lines; oblique transversal through F and E; EG is bisector. Source angle 1=50° and unknown angle 2.
audit.independent_solution: By parallel lines, angle BEF = 180 - 50 = 130 degrees. EG bisects it, so angle BEG = GEF = 65 degrees. The alternate interior angle EGF (angle 2) is 65 degrees, choice C.
